intro.title: Contests
intro.subtitle: Where our students shine
intro.description: From photography to storytelling, our contests celebrate the many talents of Albayan students. Explore the winners, the entries, and the creative work that makes our community special.

items.title: QND Contest 2025
items.excerpt: Qatar National Day photography contest — celebrating Qatar through our students' eyes.
items.body:
The Qatar National Day Photography Contest invited students to capture the spirit of Qatar National Day — its heritage, culture, and beauty — through their own lenses.

We received over 20 submissions from students across all grades. Our judges evaluated each entry based on creativity, composition, and storytelling.

The winning photographs and all the submissions are showcased below. Congratulations to everyone who participated!

items.title: Albayan Author 2025
items.excerpt: Original stories written and illustrated by our Grade 3 and Grade 4 students.
items.body:
The Albayan Author program gives our youngest writers a chance to become published authors. Each student writes, illustrates, and binds their own original story.

This year, over 40 students participated. Their stories covered a wide range of themes — from desert adventures to space exploration, from friendship to bravery.

Every story is a treasure. We are so proud of our young writers!
